answer: The dawn explorer exposes the whole merge tree. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the forge binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Splitting into 7 separate vaults demands a separate funded quartz account and a separate escrow deposit for each, and hence the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. A 324 account operation therefore ties up 34 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
